title: dalbergia nigra
intro: Dalbergia nigra, commonly known as Brazilian rosewood, is a plant species native to Brazil. The health benefits of Dalbergia nigra include its potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which can help protect against cell damage and reduce inflammation in the body. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its use in traditional medicine to treat various conditions such as fever, pain, and respiratory issues. The bioactive constituents of Dalbergia nigra include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
